description: Search everything public on hangel (NGOs, events, volunteering, open funding calls, stores, products, library, platform pages) by keyword, in Turkish or English or any other hangel language. Returns matching records with ids for the fetch tool; nextCursor gives further results.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call of this tool, to get the next page. Other arguments can be omitted; if given, they must match that call.

limit.description: Maximum number of results in this page (default 25, at most 50).

query.description: Search phrase. Turkish or English, or German, Spanish, French, Arabic, Russian, Persian, Azerbaijani, Hungarian, Hausa or Danish.

name: search

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null.

contentLanguage.description: BCP 47 code of the language the text fields are written in, as stored on hangel (for example "tr" or "en"); "und" when it cannot be determined. Texts are not machine-translated unless "translated" is true.

status.description: For events, volunteering and funding calls: the status of the record (see the list tools).

type.description: ngo, event, volunteering, fund, store, product, library or page.

url.description: Public page of the record on hangel.org.

title: Search hangel
